name: Kissed by the Baddest Boss
source: What a surprise! You received an immediate invitation to work at a prestigious laboratory right after graduation. Shortly after your arrival, more unexpected opportunities presented. Who would you choose to work with? The aloof scientist, the arrogant millionaire, the enthusiastic peer chemist or the kind but mysterious man...
translation: 真是一个惊喜！毕业后，你立即收到了在著名实验室工作的邀请。你抵达后不久，更多意想不到的机会出现了。你会选择和谁一起工作？冷漠的科学家、傲慢的百万富翁、热情的同行化学家或者善良却神秘的男人……
